segments.text: Third-year student at Houjou High School where she is regarded as an idol by her peers, having been honored with the title of Miss Houjou High for two consecutive years. A talented singer with a bright personality, she has a passion for karaoke and particularly enjoys singing "White Album", a song from the first White Album visual novel.
峰城大学政経学部3年。
華やかな容姿に似合わず、穏やかで人当たりが良くて控えめという、『ある時期を除いては』ずっと、そんな非の打ち所のない女の子。
今は付属時代よりも目立たないよう周囲に埋没しようとしているが、その、さらに深みを増した美貌や、三年前に作ってしまった“伝説”が、いつまでも彼女をアイドルの地位に縛り続けている。趣味は特になし。
彼氏の存在——不明。
峰城大付属３年Ａ組。
ミス峰城大付属二年連続制覇中。三連覇の期待がかかる高嶺の花。華やかな容姿に似合わず、穏やかで人当たりが良くて控えめという、非の打ちどころのない女の子。
…と、周囲に三年間信じ込ませることができるくらいにはいい性格で、その見えない壁を打ち破った者にだけ悪戯っぽく微笑むという。
誰にもひた隠しにしているが、趣味はヒトカ………カラオケ。
定番のオープニングナンバーは、ちょっと古めの流行歌(WHITE　ALBUM)。

Third-year student at Houjou High School who is in the same class as Haruki. While a musical genius, she’s habitually late to school and rarely pays attention during class, resulting in abysmal grades. Combined with her antisocial nature and dismissive attitude toward others, she’s ostracized by classmates and teachers alike.
多分ピアニスト。きっとウィーン在住。その他の詳細不明。
母であり、欧州を中心に世界中で活動するピアニスト冬馬曜子は、たびたび日本のメディアにもその活躍ぶりが紹介されているが、その不良娘にして実績のない若手ピアニストのことは、今現在でも日本ではまったく知られていない。彼女がふたたび日本の地を踏むことは、果たしてあり得るのか…
峰城大付属３年Ｅ組。
窓際の席で常に居眠りしている、遅刻、サボリの常習犯にして、大人はわかってくれない的な鬱屈を抱える、時代錯誤な不良娘。長く艶やかな黒髪、モデル顔負けのスタイル、切れ長の瞳というその孤高で暴力的な性格に似合いすぎる鋭利な美しさのせいで、余計に周囲との距離が広がってしまうという悪循環に陥っているが、本人は何処吹く風で強がっている。
誰にも聞かれたことはないが、どちらかと言えば緒方理奈派。

Third-year student at Houjou University majoring in literature. A tomboy with a carefree and lazy attitude, she often freeloads off Haruki and skips class. Despite her irresponsible behavior, she occasionally surprises him with moments of sharp insight and an unexpected depth of emotional intelligence.
峰城大学文学部3年。
窓際の席どころか、ゼミ室に寝袋を持ち込んで熟睡している、怠惰、無気力、依存症を絵に描いたような典型的な大学生。要領がよく甘え上手なため、今までなんとか進級してきたが、最近はさすがにゼミのレポートが増えてきたため進級が危ぶまれている。
実は興味を持ったことには寝食を忘れ熱中する性格らしいが、誰もその姿を見たことがないため真偽のほどは定かではない。
峰城大学文学部3年级学生。
要不就趴在窗边的桌子上，要不就在研究室铺个睡袋大睡特睡，惰性十足又有气无力，典型的毫无干劲大学生。
幸亏她头脑灵活，凡事都能很快上手，也就一直顺利升级。只是最近研究班的报告多了不少，升级似乎没那么顺利了。
也许她是那种一旦来了兴致就会全身心投入的人。不过由于没人见识过她那种姿态，实在不知是真是假。

Third-year student at Houjou High School where she excels academically and used to be the vice-captain of the tennis team. Much like a certain someone, stepping in to help others with their problems comes naturally to her, even if it means being nosy about it and putting her own needs last.
峰城大付属3年A組。
前期クラス委員長。元テニス部副主将。
真面目で堅実で親身な世話と的確な助言が心地良いという、言い方を変えれば誰かとそっくりな性格の少女。身長を始めサイズは全体的に控えめだが前向きな積極性でカバー。…ほんの少しだけコンプレックスはあるが、弱みは絶対に見せない。友達も多く、特にクラスの仲良し四人組とは固い絆で結ばれた間柄。もちろん仲間内でもリーダー格で、もし親友が傷つけられたりすれば、黙っていられるはずもなく…
峰城大附属学校3年A组，上学期的班级委员长，原网球部副主将。
一本正经又有点顽固，其实心地善良，照顾人更是无微不至，也会给予他人最正确的建议。稍微改下语气的话就跟某人一模一样了。
还处在长身体的阶段，难免过于娇小，幸亏积极乐观的个性很好地弥补了这点。
——虽然对此多少有点自卑，但绝不会因此展露柔弱一面。
有很多朋友，尤其和班里同学组成了关系特别好的四人组。
当然，她在朋友圈里也是老大级别的，要是有人伤了她的朋友，她绝不会袖手旁观。

Manager at the editing department of Kaiousha's Kaiou Graph magazine and Haruki's boss, she is a workaholic among workaholics who relentlessly prioritizes her career above all else. Her uncompromising drive for professional success often comes at the expense of personal relationships and emotional fulfillment.
開桜社という中堅どころの出版社に勤務している雑誌編集者。
若手と言うには語弊があるがベテランと言われる筋合いもないお年頃。同期の中では男女関係なく一番の出世頭で、将来の編集長筆頭候補。眠っているところを見た者はいないほどの仕事中毒者であり、周囲の羨望と嫉妬と尊敬と恐怖を一身に集めるが、どうせ誰も彼女に勝てないので大した意味はない。その凛々しさも相まって典型的な『高めすぎて男が寄って来ない』タイプ。
在出版界的业内霸主——开樱社任职的杂志编辑。
说她是新手着实有点不正确，但她也还不到被称之为“老手”的年龄。
相同年龄段的男女同事中就她晋升最快，已经是下任主编的候补人选了。
工作狂，热心到甚至无人看过她休息时的模样。集周围人们的羡慕、嫉妒、尊敬、害怕于一身，其实也无所谓，反正没人赢得了她。
向来威风凛凛，典型的“出色过头以致男性都不敢靠近的女强人”。
The protagonist of White Album 2.

Third-year student at Houjou High School where he is a model student and the rhythm guitarist of the Light Music Club. A well-meaning busybody with a strong sense of responsibility, he's always eager to helps others to the point of intrusiveness but has tendencies to disregard his own well-being while doing so.

Third-year student at Houjou High School and former captain of the basketball team. A straightforward tomboy who never hesitates to speak her mind, she’s in the same class as Setsuna and has been friends with Takeya and Haruki for a long time.

Third-year student at Houjou High School, he serves as the president and lead guitarist of the Light Music Club. Carefree and infamous as a womanizer, he nonetheless cares deeply for his close friends—especially Haruki, to whom he is fiercely loyal yet unafraid to call out when he makes mistakes.
Competitor for the title of Miss Houjou and rival of Setsuna. She isn’t afraid to bend situations to her advantage, using her charm and wits whenever it suits her.
Third-year student at Houjou High School and Koharu's friend. She’s quiet and soft-spoken who doesn’t draw attention to herself.
Manager at the Japanese branch of Touma Youko Office PLC. While it's her job to support her boss, there's a sincerity in the way she does it that goes beyond obligation.
Waitress at the Minami-Suetsugu branch of the Goodies restaurant. She enjoys gossiping and teasing her coworkers about their quirks, but never with any ill intent and always keeps it lighthearted.

Mari's best friend from high school who works at a prestigious travel agency. Though she delights in teasing Mari, her fierce loyalty and unwavering support prove there's no one more dependable in her corner.
Third-year student at Houjou High School and Koharu's friend. She’s considerate and tends to go along with the flow of things.
Guidance counselor at Houjou High School.
Member of the Watos Troupe theater club.
Homeroom teacher for Haruki and Kazusa's class at Houjou High School.
Third-year student at Houjou High School who is in the same class as Haruki. He has a relaxed, easygoing vibe, never seeming too bothered by the events around him.
Setsuna and Takahiro's father. While he maintains a distant and reserved demeanor toward most people, his love for his children runs deep to the point of being overprotective.
Setsuna and Takahiro's mother. A homemaker who ensures her family feels loved and supported, while keeping the household lively with her teasing.
Third-year middle school student and Setsuna's younger brother. Though his grades aren’t the best, his charisma makes him popular with others.
Kazusa's mother and a world-famous pianist who is primarily based in Europe. Known for her playful and eccentric personality, she lives life on her own extravagant terms.
Third-year student at Houjou High School and Koharu's friend. She's assertive with a straightforward attitude, and believes in setting things straight when necessary.
Acting manager of the Minami-Suetsugu branch of the Goodies restaurant. Despite his position, he is quite passive and often relies on others to help manage his responsibilities.
Line cook at the Minami-Suetsugu branch of the Goodies restaurant.

Manager at the editing department of Kaiousha's Kaiou Graph magazine. Meticulous and committed to his work, he can be short-tempered at times, but his frustrations stem from a firm sense of duty and he never stays angry for long.
Staff employee of the editing department of Kaiousha's Kaiou Graph magazine. While he fulfills his responsibilities, he is lax in his approach and shows little motivation beyond the minimum required.
Staff employee of the editing department of Kaiousha's Kaiou Graph magazine.
Staff employee of the editing department of Kaiousha's Kaiou Graph magazine. She’s a reliable, routine-driven office worker with a curious streak and a playful habit of teasing her colleagues.

President of the Watos Troupe theater club and a seventh-year student at Houjou University facing academic dismissal due to his extended time in school. Despite this looming threat, he continues to prioritize the success of his theater club.
Member of the Watos Troupe theater club. Though not exceptionally talented in acting, he compensates through hard work and dedication.
Chief medical director at Houjou University Hospital.
